cases.situation: I replied-all on a client thread and it went to their whole distribution list, including my boss Karen's joke that their CFO is 'hard work'. Need to tell Karen on Slack right now.
cases.reply: Karen, heads up: at 11:20 I replied-all on the Northwind thread and it went to their full distribution list, including your line about their CFO. I've recalled it, which caught about half the recipients, and I've drafted a short note to Priya at Northwind that I'd like you to see before it goes. I can have it in your DMs in 10 minutes. Sorry, this one's mine. From now on I strip external addresses before replying on any internal thread.
cases.note: A recall is only a partial fix, so say exactly how partial; overclaiming the fix is the second mistake.

cases.situation: I put the wrong date for the team offsite in the calendar invite I sent to everyone. Small thing but people might book trains. Posting in the team channel.
cases.reply: Correction: the offsite is Thursday 29 October, not Friday. My mistake, the invite's updated. If you've already booked travel for Friday, message me and I'll sort the change.
cases.note: Small mistake, small message. One line of ownership, then the fix.

cases.situation: 我是公司出纳，昨天给供应商重复付了一笔货款，多付了38,000元，今天对账才发现。要跟财务总监王总说，怎么开口？
cases.reply: 王总，向您报告一个我的失误：昨天给华诚包装付款时重复提交了一次，多付了38,000元，今天上午对账时发现的。我已经联系了对方财务刘姐，她确认收到两笔，同意本周五前退回，我会盯到到账。原因是我提交前没有核对付款记录。以后每笔付款提交前，我都先在系统里查一遍历史记录。钱到账后我第一时间告诉您。
cases.note: 先说错误和金额，再说已经做了什么，最后一句防范措施，不要反复道歉。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance email marketer. This morning I sent my client Rachel's newsletter to 8,400 subscribers with the code FALL40 instead of FALL14. 31 orders have already used it. I need to email her now.
cases.reply: Hi Rachel, I made a mistake in this morning's newsletter: the discount code went out as FALL40, 40% off, instead of FALL14. So far 31 orders have used it, roughly $1,100 more in discounts than planned. I turned FALL40 off at 11:20, so no new orders can use it. I'll send you the full list of those 31 orders by 2pm, and I'll credit the extra discount against this month's invoice. From now on I'll send you a test email with the live code before every send. I'm sorry about this one.
cases.note: To a client, lead with the number and the fix already made, offer to carry the cost, and apologise once, at the end.

cases.situation: I'm a junior analyst. Two weeks ago I sent the Q3 pricing deck to our VP, Marisa, and just found a formula error: monthly churn is 4.1%, not 2.4%. She's already quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for the October 8 meeting. I need to tell my manager Tom first.
cases.reply: Tom, I found an error in the Q3 pricing deck I sent on 15 September: monthly churn on slide 6 should be 4.1%, not 2.4%. A formula pointed at the wrong range, and Marisa has quoted the 2.4% in the board pre-read for 8 October. I've corrected the deck and rechecked every other figure against the source data, and the rest holds. Can we tell Marisa together today, so she has the corrected slide before the pre-read goes out? From now on I'll have a second person check any number that goes to the VP.
cases.note: Error found late and already quoted upward: tell your manager first, bring the fix, and ask to escalate together the same day.

cases.situation: 我是部门经理，答应帮组员陈佳提交今年的晋升材料，结果系统9月25号就截止了，我记成了30号，没交上。她还不知道，今天要跟她说。
cases.reply: 佳佳，有件事要跟你说清楚：你的晋升材料我没在9月25号截止前提交，我把日期记成了30号，责任完全在我。今天上午我已经找了HR的周姐，她说可以走补录，需要部门总监签字，我下午就去找刘总，明天下班前把结果告诉你。如果补录不成，明年3月那一轮我第一个提你，并把这次的情况写进说明。对不起，这件事受影响的是你。以后所有截止日期我都会提前一周设提醒。
cases.note: 经理向下属认错也要先说结论和责任，再说补救和时间，别让她反过来安慰你。

cases.situation: 今朝、取引先の山本様に旧単価のままの見積書を送ってしまい、部長に報告したら「またか。先月も似たようなミスがあったよね」と言われた。訂正版はもう送ってある。どう返せばいい？
cases.reply: おっしゃる通りです。先月に続いてのミスで、申し訳ありません。訂正版は10時半に送付済みで、山本様にはお電話でも経緯をお伝えしました。今後は見積書を送る前に単価表の更新日を確認し、佐藤さんにダブルチェックをお願いします。山本様から返事があり次第、すぐにご報告します。
cases.note: 二度目だと言われても言い訳はせずに認め、具体的な再発防止策を一つ示し、あとはこまめな報告で信頼を取り戻す。

cases.situation: I was cleaning up our team's shared slide deck last night and accidentally deleted my colleague Priya's six slides for her client pitch this Thursday. I restored four from version history but two are gone. She doesn't know yet.
cases.reply: Priya, I need to flag something: last night I deleted your six slides in the shared Harlow deck while I was tidying it up. I've restored four from version history, slides 12 to 15, and they're exactly as you left them. Slides 16 and 17, the pricing comparison, didn't come back. I'm sorry, that's on me. I can rebuild them from the pricing sheet this morning and have them to you by 1pm for you to check, if that helps. From now on I'll make my own copy before I tidy a shared deck.
cases.note: To a peer whose work you broke: the damage precisely, what's already recovered, an offer to do the rebuild yourself, and one prevention step.

cases.situation: 我是后端开发。今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时发送任务配置写错了，大约12000个用户每人收到了三条一样的短信。10:32我已经回滚。要马上在工作群里跟技术负责人周总说。
cases.reply: 周总，报告一个我的失误：今天上午10:15上线订单提醒功能时，我把发送任务配置错了，大约12000个用户每人重复收到三条相同的短信，多出的短信费约1200元。10:32已经回滚，之后没有再发出重复短信。客服的统一回复口径我已经发给小林，11点前把受影响用户名单和费用明细发您。对不起，这次是我的问题。以后批量发送类功能上线前，我都先在测试环境按真实用户量跑一遍，再请一位同事复核配置。
cases.note: 先说错误和影响范围，再说已经止损和下一步的时间，最后一条具体的防范措施；只道歉一次，不解释为什么会写错。

cases.situation: I'm a project coordinator at an architecture firm. This morning I submitted the Elm Street extension planning application to the council with the August drawings instead of the revised set, and the council has already validated it. My director Paul is on site, so I'm calling him now.
cases.reply: Paul, quick one, and it's my mistake: this morning I submitted the Elm Street planning application with the August drawings, not the revised set. The council validated it at 11, so it's in their system with the old roof height. I've already emailed the planning officer, Ms Okafor, to ask whether we can swap the drawings or need to withdraw and resubmit, and asked her to call me today. I'm sorry. I'll text you her answer as soon as I have it and send you a written summary before 5. From now on I'll check the revision number on every drawing against the register before anything goes to the council.
cases.note: Big mistake, boss out of the office: call first, keep it spoken and short, and promise the written summary with a time.

cases.situation: My manager Deepa just messaged me 'Why am I hearing from finance that Monday's invoice batch failed?' I spotted it yesterday afternoon and was planning to fix it before telling her. 46 invoices, about $38,000, didn't go out.
cases.reply: You should have heard it from me yesterday, Deepa, and that's on me. Monday's batch failed for 46 invoices, about $38,000, because I uploaded the file with last quarter's tax code. I've corrected the file and it's re-running now; finance will confirm by 3pm and I'll forward it to you straight away. From now on I'll flag a problem the moment I see it, even before I have the fix.
cases.note: When your boss finds out first, own the delay as its own mistake in the first line, then give the facts and the fix.

cases.situation: Ich bin Werkstudentin in einer kleinen Webagentur und kümmere mich um die Domainverlängerungen. Die Domain unseres Kunden Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Kreditkarte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail übersehen habe. Website und E-Mail sind seit 6 Uhr down, und ich muss es meinem Chef Herrn Brandt sagen.
cases.reply: Herr Brandt, ich muss Ihnen einen Fehler melden: Die Domain von Bäckerei Hoffmann ist heute Nacht abgelaufen, weil die hinterlegte Karte ungültig war und ich die Warnmail vom 15. September übersehen habe. Website und Postfächer sind seit etwa 6 Uhr nicht erreichbar. Ich habe die Domain um 8:40 mit der Firmenkarte verlängert; laut Anbieter kann es bis zu 24 Stunden dauern, bis alles wieder läuft, und ich melde mich um 12 Uhr mit dem Stand. Soll ich Frau Hoffmann selbst anrufen, oder möchten Sie das übernehmen? Es tut mir leid. Ab heute stehen alle Ablaufdaten im Teamkalender, mit Erinnerung zwei Wochen vorher.
cases.note: Wenn die Lösung noch läuft: sagen, was schon getan ist, wann das nächste Update kommt, und beim Kundenkontakt fragen statt eigenmächtig handeln.

cases.situation: In standup this morning our lead Anna said Leo's deploy broke staging yesterday. It was actually my config change at 4:10pm; Leo deployed right after me and it surfaced then. Leo looked embarrassed and didn't say anything. I want to message Anna now.
cases.reply: Anna, a correction to this morning: staging broke yesterday because of my config change at 4:10pm, not Leo's deploy. His went out right after mine, which is why it looked like his. I reverted my change at 9:20 today and staging has been green since. I'm sorry, and I'm sorry Leo took the heat for it in standup. I'd like to say this in the team channel too so the record is straight, unless you'd rather do it. From now on I'll post in #deploys before any config change to staging.
cases.note: When someone else was blamed for your mistake, correcting the record the same day, publicly and to them, is part of the fix.

cases.situation: I'm the office coordinator at a physiotherapy clinic. An hour ago I emailed our linen supplier a spreadsheet meant for our billing company: 230 patients' names, phone numbers and appointment dates. I need to tell the practice manager, Helen.
cases.reply: Helen, I need to flag a mistake: at 10:15 I emailed Crisp Linen a spreadsheet meant for our billing company, with 230 patients' names, phone numbers and appointment dates. I've called their office manager, Dave, and asked him to delete it and confirm in writing; he's doing that now. I'm sorry, I picked the wrong contact from autofill. Because it's patient data, I think we should check today whether our data protection policy means it has to be reported. Can we go through that together before lunch? From now on I'll password-protect any file with patient details before it leaves the clinic.
cases.note: With personal data, part of the fix is checking reporting duties the same day; don't decide on your own that it's harmless.

cases.situation: I teach Year 9 maths. The algebra test grades I posted to the parent portal last Friday were wrong: my answer key for question 7 had an error, so all 28 students lost 4 marks they'd earned. Three parents have already emailed, and I want to message all the parents.
cases.reply: Dear parents, I made a marking error on last Friday's algebra test: my answer key for question 7 was wrong, so every student lost 4 marks they had earned. I've corrected all 28 papers, and the updated grades are on the portal now; every score has gone up by 4. I explained the mistake to the class this morning as well. I'm sorry for the confusion, especially if you'd already talked the result through at home. From now on I'll work through every answer key myself before I mark a test. Ms Harper
cases.note: To a whole group of parents: one message to everyone, the fix already live, and no need for them to chase you individually.

cases.situation: 上周交的差旅报销里，我不小心把一张私人聚餐的发票（426元）也夹进去了，今天发现时报销款已经打到我卡上。想跟财务李姐说清楚。
cases.reply: 李姐，跟您说一个我的失误：上周三提交的差旅报销里混进了一张我私人聚餐的发票，金额426元，报销款已经到账了。我今天上午核对时发现的，这426元我今天就退回公司，麻烦告诉我走哪个流程、转到哪个账户。以后提交前我会把私人票据单独放开，逐张核对后再交。对不起，给您添麻烦了。
cases.note: 涉及钱的错误，主动说、马上退，不解释为什么会混进去；一条具体的防范措施就够了。

cases.situation: I left my work laptop on the 18:40 train home last night. I reported it to the rail company's lost property at 20:00 and to IT at 07:30 this morning; IT has locked it remotely and it's encrypted, but it has the Hartley client files on it and it hasn't been found yet. I need to tell my manager, Owen.
cases.reply: Owen, I need to flag something: I left my work laptop on the 18:40 train last night, and it hasn't been found yet. It's encrypted and IT locked it remotely at 07:30 this morning, but it has the Hartley client files on it. I reported it to rail lost property at 20:00 and I'll chase them again at noon. I'm sorry, that's on me. Can we check with IT today whether anything needs to go to Hartley or be reported under our data policy? From now on the laptop stays in my bag on my lap when I travel.
cases.note: When the outcome is still open, say what is contained, what isn't, and ask to check reporting duties the same day rather than deciding it's harmless.

cases.situation: I'm an account manager in London. This morning I missed a 9am call with our client Hiroshi Tanaka in Tokyo because I'd put it in my calendar as 9am London time; he waited 15 minutes. The call was to agree the Q4 delivery schedule, and I've since set my calendar to show both time zones.
cases.reply: Dear Mr Tanaka, I missed our 9am call this morning, and that was my mistake: I entered it in my calendar in London time instead of Tokyo time. I'm sorry you waited 15 minutes for me. I'd still like to agree the Q4 delivery schedule this week, so could we speak at 9am Tokyo time on Thursday 1 October or Friday 2 October? I've set my calendar to show both time zones so this doesn't happen again.
cases.note: To a client, own it in one line, then put the effort into making the reschedule easy.

cases.situation: I changed our nightly sales sync on Monday evening. Today my colleague Ines noticed Tuesday's dashboard total is about 3% below the till system; my change seems to be dropping rows, but I don't know why yet. I've already rolled the sync back to last week's version, so tonight's run should be clean. Need to tell my manager Kofi on Slack.
cases.reply: Kofi, heads up: the change I made to the nightly sales sync on Monday evening is dropping rows. Ines spotted that Tuesday's dashboard total is about 3% below the till system. I've rolled the sync back to last week's version, so tonight's run should be clean. I don't know the cause yet; I'm comparing Tuesday's rows against the till export first to see which sales are missing, and I'll update you by 3pm today. Sorry, this one's mine. Once I've found it, I'll add a nightly check that flags any gap between the two totals.
cases.note: Report before you have the root cause: what's contained, what you're checking first, and when the next update comes.

cases.situation: I'm an account executive. On last Thursday's sales call I told Oakridge Dental that our payroll integration was live, but it's only on the roadmap for Q1. They signed a 40-seat annual contract on Monday, and their ops lead, Hannah, asked this morning when she can switch it on. I need to tell my manager, Chris, on Slack before I answer her.
cases.reply: Chris, I need to flag a mistake: on last Thursday's call I told Oakridge Dental our payroll integration was live, and it's only on the Q1 roadmap. They signed the 40-seat annual contract on Monday, and Hannah, their ops lead, asked this morning when she can switch it on. I haven't replied to her yet. I'd like to tell her the truth today, with the Q1 timeline and what we can offer until then; can we agree the message by 2pm? Sorry, this one's mine. From now on I'll check the live features page before I promise anything on a call.
cases.note: Tell your manager before the customer, and don't paper over the gap in your reply to Hannah; what Oakridge is owed is a joint decision.

cases.situation: 我是装修公司的项目经理。业主刘女士卫生间的墙砖定的是浅灰哑光，我下单时选成了浅灰亮光，工人昨天已经铺完一面墙，她还没去现场看。公司同意拆掉重铺，费用我们出；正确的砖周五（10月2日）到货，整体完工要从10月9日推到10月13日。
cases.reply: 刘女士，跟您说一个我的失误：卫生间墙砖您定的是浅灰哑光，我下单时选成了浅灰亮光，昨天工人已经铺完一面墙。这面墙我们拆掉重铺，费用全部由公司承担。正确的哑光砖周五（10月2日）到货，整体完工时间从10月9日推到10月13日。对不起，是我没核对清楚。以后每次下单前，我都会把型号发给您确认后再下。
cases.note: 向业主认错：错在哪、怎么补救、谁承担费用、新的完工日期一次说清，不推给供应商或工人。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance bookkeeper. This morning I realised I filed my client Anja's quarterly sales tax return two days late, because I'd put the wrong deadline in my calendar. I filed it an hour ago, and the tax office's online account now shows a $150 late-filing penalty, which I'll pay myself.
cases.reply: Anja, I need to tell you about a mistake I made: I filed your quarterly sales tax return two days late, because I had the wrong deadline in my calendar. I filed it this morning, and the tax office's online account now shows a $150 late-filing penalty, which I'll pay myself. I'll send you the payment confirmation by Friday 2 October. From today, every client deadline goes into my calendar with a reminder a week ahead. Sorry for this one.
cases.note: When your mistake costs a client money, say who pays in the same message as the mistake; they shouldn't have to ask.

cases.situation: 我和同事小李一起做给客户的月度报告，我负责的销售数据那页用成了8月的数据，报告昨天已经发给客户周经理。小李负责的部分没问题。我已经把9月的正确数据更新好了，要跟组长陈姐说。
cases.reply: 陈姐，报告一个我的失误：昨天发给周经理的月度报告里，销售数据那页我用成了8月的数据，这页是我负责的，小李那部分没问题。9月的正确数据已经更新好，更正版和给周经理的说明邮件我10分钟内发您过目，您确认后今天就发出。对不起，这次是我的问题。以后报告发出前，我会逐页核对数据的月份和来源。
cases.note: 合作的成果出了错，只认自己那部分，说清楚同事没问题，但不借此撇清，也不把锅推给流程。
